architecture_gap.name: WP206_LEGACY_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_UNAUTHENTICATED
architecture_gap.description: WP206 G4 binds repeat recovery to the same opaque recovery_provenance_ref string, but the canonical recovery boundary does not derive that identity from or verify a concrete immutable evidence subject. Therefore string equality proves reference equality, not evidence-content identity. This is an evidence-authentication gap only; existing one-time/CAS state-transition controls remain valid at their accepted scope.

reuse_analysis.reason: bind_restart_sources requires CausalIdentity plus concrete PersistentAgencyCheckpoint, WholePersistentLoopSeal, LoopOutcomeEvidence and PersistedRestartEvidence; WP206 legacy migration provenance may denote a different historical evidence object.
reuse_analysis.pattern: Require a concrete typed source/evidence object and derive canonical principal IDs/digests from it before invoking the already-accepted deterministic recovery transition; never accept a second caller-controlled identity set as equivalent evidence.

smallest_reusable_mechanism.name: LegacyRecoveryEvidenceSubject/v1
smallest_reusable_mechanism.placement: thin adapter immediately before recover_legacy_g1_checkpoint_authority; preserve the existing recovery transaction/CAS as the deterministic inner transition
smallest_reusable_mechanism.derivation_law: evidence_sha256 must be computed from canonical bytes/a concrete typed evidence object by the adapter; it must not be accepted as an unauthenticated caller assertion at the canonical ingress
smallest_reusable_mechanism.binding_law: persist evidence_sha256 with the existing same-UnifiedDB recovery record and include it in recovery_id; exact repeat must preserve checkpoint, legacy receipt, rebound authority and evidence subject digest
smallest_reusable_mechanism.source_ref_law: evidence_source_ref is provenance/navigation metadata; it cannot substitute for evidence_sha256
smallest_reusable_mechanism.authority_law: the subject object has no truth/effect/completion authority and creates no second state store

integration_shape: typed legacy evidence object or immutable evidence bytes
-> validate schema + checkpoint/legacy-receipt claims against concrete WP206 source checkpoint
-> same canonical UnifiedDB recovery row with evidence subject digest

authentication_threat_model.trusted_local_migration_caller: typed content-addressed subject is sufficient for the observed mutable/opaque-reference gap
authentication_threat_model.untrusted_or_adversarial_evidence_produc: content digest alone proves integrity/identity, not producer authority; require a separately admitted signer/verifier/trust root only if this threat model becomes explicit

rollback_analysis: WP206 already has a unique checkpoint recovery row, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and compare-and-swap authority replacement. TUF-like monotone metadata adds little unless multiple legitimate recovery-evidence revisions are introduced. Do not add revision machinery preemptively.
negative_tests_required: same evidence_source_ref with changed evidence bytes/evidence_sha256 must fail closed
evidence subject checkpoint_id or checkpoint_sha256 mismatch must fail closed
evidence subject legacy_authority_receipt_sha256 mismatch must fail closed
caller-supplied expected evidence hash that disagrees with digest derived from concrete evidence must fail closed
post-first-recovery evidence subject digest drift must fail closed
existing conflicting repeat provenance test remains fail closed
existing G3 legacy recovery and G4 repeat provenance suites remain green

alias_policy.recommended: bind both canonical normalized source ref and evidence digest for exact-repeat audit stability; evidence digest is the content identity and ref remains provenance metadata
alias_policy.reason: accepting arbitrary alias changes after first recovery reduces audit reproducibility even if content is identical

efficiency.runtime_shape: one canonicalization/hash plus constant-size row fields on an exceptional legacy-migration path
efficiency.expected_overhead: negligible relative to SQLite transaction and checkpoint validation

falsifier: If exact-current WP206 source already derives recovery provenance from an immutable typed evidence object and persists/verifies its digest, retire this delta as redundant.
